text: Fixed - all claims corrected rather than wiring the estimator in, since a correct robust sandwich needs the M-estimator influence-function form, not the OLS expression. R/sandwich_variance_doc.R now states plainly that sandwich variance is NOT applied by fmri_lm() and that the robust path reports a model-based WLS variance; its Effective Degrees of Freedom section was also wrong (it advertised an AR factor (n-p_AR)/n that the code never computed) and now documents the robust scaling plus Satterthwaite. README.md no longer lists sandwich estimators under Robust estimation. CLAUDE.md has a dated correction noting the item overstated what shipped and that the arithmetic bug survived because the test asserted only dimensions and positivity. man/sandwich_variance.Rd regenerated.
